name: The Pharaoh's True Heiress
overview: Naga was switched at birth and raised in a craftsman village, fighting in underground matches to support her adoptive mother. To save her dying mother, she goes to the royal court to claim her identity as the pharaoh's trueborn daughter. But the false princess is deeply loved, and Naga is met with coldness and framed plots.  Without tears or tantrums, Naga joins the worst "Abyss Group," wins first place in the Underworld Trial, inherits the Eye of Ra, and becomes a divine avatar. With her charisma, she unites a band of outcast lowborn nobles and forms her own guard. Finally, she defeats the pharaoh's eldest son and is crowned Queen of Upper and Lower Egypt. The false princess is dethroned and imprisoned, while her once-biased parents regret forever.
